thread:
marta (sales): Hey team — acme wants a SOC 2 excerpt + a bridge/ack letter so they can start a 2-week POC on Dedicated. Also asked for an NDA before we share docs and for temporary console/log access during the POC. Can legal + security advise on what we can share now vs after NDA? cc @tom (legal) @kevin (security)

 tom (legal): We can provide a redacted SOC 2 excerpt (opinion page + scope + control families). We do not share detailed control IDs, internal diagrams, or auditor workpapers. For bridge letters: we can issue an interim acknowledgement that covers the period until they receive the full SOC 2 report, but we need to confirm the exact wording with compliance. Also need to know whether the customer requires a mutual NDA or one-way.

 marta (sales): They requested a mutual NDA. They also want read-only access to certain logs and the console for debugging the POC. Is that feasible without extra contract terms?

 kevin (security): Short answer: yes, with limits. We can provide: 1) redacted logs via sanitized export (S3 presigned link) OR 2) time-limited console sessions via temporary IAM role with CloudWatch/ReadOnly permissions. We avoid broad console write access. For any session we require an approved customer contact list and an authorized engineer name to be added to the access ticket. Also: no screenshots of internal telemetry that include hostnames or internal IPs — we must sanitize.

 jess (eng): For the Dedicated POC we need a ticket to reserve capacity. We'll pin the runtime to model v1.2.0-optimized and block autoscaling beyond the reserved pool. If they expect heavy traffic, pricing needs to be clear up front — typically a small reserved credit + overage on usage. Who will own the pricing conversation?

 marta (sales): I'll own pricing. For docs: can legal draft the mutual NDA + provide the SOC 2 excerpt and the bridge-letter template we usually use? We want to send everything in one packet so the customer can sign and we can provision access quickly (goal: 48 hours).

 tom (legal): I have a bridge-letter template we can adapt. Key points: dates covered, scope limited to hosted inference service, statement of SOC 2 coverage in scope, and explicit mention that full report will be provided under NDA when available. We'll mark the excerpt as "REDACTED FOR CONFIDENTIALITY" and embed the report date. I prefer DocuSign for mutal NDAs, schedule: I can prepare the NDA + adapted bridge letter and SOC excerpt link by EOD tomorrow if you confirm mutual NDA.

 kevin (security): Once NDA is executed, compliance-bot will log the disclosure. I'll need: customer org domain, list of authorized emails, and the exact resources they need (console read-only? logs S3?). After that, I can provision a 48-hour read-only session or generate a presigned S3 link with 7-day expiry for log exports. Provision ETA: 24-48 hours after NDA is signed.

 compliance-bot: NOTE: Per policy SH-3, SOC 2 excerpts shared externally must exclude auditor workpapers and internal control identifiers. All disclosures require a documented recipient list in the sharing ticket.

 marta (sales): Customer is acme-corp.com. Authorized users: alice@acme-corp.com, ben@acme-corp.com. They asked for console read-only and access to request/response logs for the POC. I'll ask them to sign mutual NDA via DocuSign and will attach the POC SOW.

 tom (legal): Sounds good. I'll prepare: 1) mutual NDA (DocuSign), 2) redacted SOC 2 excerpt (PDF with watermark), 3) bridge-letter draft addressed to ACME, and 4) a short cover email. I'll cc kevin on the share ticket.

 jess (eng): Once NDA is inbound, open a JIRA ticket to eng-ops with the customer emails and desired window. We'll also need a billing contact to authorize trial credits.

 marta (sales): I'll open the JIRA and send NDA invite now. Plan: NDA -> sign (aim 48h) -> legal uploads redacted SOC2 + bridge letter -> security provisions read-only -> eng reserves capacity.

 kevin (security): One more thing: if they want log-level request payloads, we need explicit approval from product risk (PII redaction). If PII is present we must remove it before sharing.

 marta (sales): noted. I'll ask them to identify whether test data will contain PII. Thanks all — will update thread once NDA is sent. :raised_hands:

 tom (legal): Ping me once it's sent, I'll prioritize.

 compliance-bot: ACTION: create disclosure record #D-2026-134 when SOC2 excerpt is uploaded.

 marta (sales): NDA sent (DocuSign). Doc link: https://docusign.example/abc123 (will update with signed link).

 tom (legal): Got it — I'll review routing. If signed today I can upload the redacted excerpt and bridge letter by EOD tomorrow.

 kevin (security): I'll standby to provision read-only access once we have the signed NDA and the disclosure record. ETA 24 hours after both are present.

 marta (sales): Customer acknowledged DocuSign notification. Thanks team — will follow up here after signature.
